class.name: PuertsV8Backend
class.brief_description: Creates ECMAScript runtimes backed by V8.
class.description: Pass an instance to [method PuertsEnvironment.initialize] to select V8. Supports [method PuertsEnvironment.tick], inspector debugging, low-memory notification, and execution termination. Use either V8 or Node.js in a process; loading both can cause conflicts.

method.name: _puerts_get_functions_ptr
method.description: Internal interface used by [method PuertsEnvironment.initialize] to obtain the backend function table.
